svg.aria-label: Three lenses side by side. Suspicion: a ticket saying database issue, with the question does the evidence actually say that. Timestamps: a timeline with deploy at 2am and an error at 3am, and the gap between them circled with the question what happened in between. Questions: a function that catches every exception, with the question why, who was afraid of what.
svg.text: not a skill from a tutorial. a habit built from every bug you've been wrong about.
